aiDescription: Adds a variety of ships and weapons to the Indies and Pirates factions, ranging from small scavenger frigates to capital ships. Includes deployable defense frigates, long-range artillery that explodes on impact, and hullmods for carriers and exploration vessels. The mod also introduces industry and structures related to building an isolated scavenger empire.
